description: Use for questions across several QuickBooks companies like "combine our QuickBooks companies", "group P&L across all our QuickBooks entities", "consolidated balance sheet for the group", "how is the group doing across our QuickBooks companies", "eliminate intercompany between our QuickBooks entities", or "put our US and Canada QuickBooks books in one currency" — even when the user never says "consolidation".
